function.name: write_solution
function.arguments:
{"content": "import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem and_left (a b : Bool) (h : (a && b) = true) : a = true := by
  cases a with
  | false => cases h
  | true => rfl

theorem and_right (a b : Bool) (h : (a && b) = true) : b = true := by
  cases a with
  | false => cases h
  | true => cases b with
    | false => cases h
    | true => rfl

theorem or_right (a b : Bool) (h : (a || b) = true) (ha : a = false) : b = true := by
  cases b with
  | false =>
    cases a with
    | false => cases h
    | true => exact absurd ha (fun hh => Bool.noConfusion hh)
  | true => rfl

theorem dec_eq_true (b : Bool) (h : decide (b = true) = true) : b = true := by
  cases b with
  | false => cases h
  | true => rfl

theorem dec_eq_false (b : Bool) (h : decide (b = true) = false) : b = false := by
  cases b with
  | false => rfl
  | true => cases h

theorem accEq_sound : ∀ (a b : Account), accEq a b = true → a = b
  | [], [] => fun _ => rfl
  | [], _ :: _ => fun h => by cases h
  | _ :: _, [] => fun h => by cases h
  | a :: as, b :: bs => fun h => by
    have h1 : (accEq (a :: as) (b :: bs)) = true := h
    rw [Wallet.accEq] at h1
    cases hd : decide (a = b) with
    | false => rw [hd] at h1; cases h1
    | true =>
      have h2 : accEq as bs = true := by rw [hd] at h1; exact h1
      have hab : a = b := of_decide_eq_true hd
      rw [hab, accEq_sound as bs h2]

end Solution
"}
